mcp_title: Buenos Aires events in your AI assistant
mcp_intro: Connect BA Eventos to your AI assistant to search current events in Buenos Aires without leaving your chat.
mcp_endpoint_copy_failed: Could not copy. Select and copy the endpoint manually.
mcp_claude_step_open: In Claude on web or desktop, open Customize → Connectors.
mcp_claude_step_add: Choose + Add → Add custom connector and name it BA Eventos.
mcp_claude_step_url: Paste the endpoint above. Continue past the detected authentication settings.
mcp_claude_step_auth: Select No sign in under Authentication, then finish with Add.
mcp_claude_step_enable: In a chat, open + → Connectors and enable BA Eventos.
mcp_claude_workspace_note: In a Team or Enterprise workspace, an owner may need to add it first.
mcp_chatgpt_step_open: Open ChatGPT on the web and go to Plugins.
mcp_chatgpt_step_add: Choose + → Add custom MCP server. Name it BA Eventos and paste the endpoint above as the Server URL.
mcp_chatgpt_step_auth: Choose No authentication, review the notice, then select Create as a plugin.
mcp_chatgpt_step_install: Find BA Eventos in your personal plugins and install it.
mcp_chatgpt_step_enable: Start a new Work chat, type @ and select BA Eventos, then ask about events.
mcp_chatgpt_workspace_note: Your workspace must allow custom MCP servers.
mcp_search_events: Search the event catalog with filters such as date, neighborhood, category, and budget.
mcp_get_event: Retrieve details and source links for one event.
mcp_example: Find free live music in Palermo this Friday
mcp_limits: Read-only. No BA Eventos account is needed. Searches return up to 5 results. Limit: 10 tool calls per minute per IP.
mcp_signpost: Using an AI assistant? Connect BA Eventos — Public beta
